All codes supporting this publication can be found at https://gitlab.com/mkoenen2/dimer_cohort.

fields.value:
Metadata for DIMER study.
To run the Rmarkdown found at https://gitlab.com/mkoenen2/dimer_cohort 3 datafiles are needed. These datafiles are available upon request and contain:

1. The Clinical_data.dat file contains clinical and immunological data from participants in the DIMER study. All participants have received a pseudoID.

2. The RTIsymptom_meta.dat contains daily RTI symptoms measured with a diary cellphone application as well as the data from montly questionnaires in the subgroup of children that participated in RTI symptom registration during four winter months.

3. The Check_distribution_PAD.csv shows the distribution of antibody deficiency diagnoses in children for the entire cohort and children referred to hospital from their general practisioner.

files.description: The data are sensitive since they involve personal information of patients. There are also restrictions on use by commercial parties, and on sharing openly based on (inter)national laws and regulations and written informed consent. Therefore these data (and additional clinical data) are only available upon signing a Data Sharing Agreement (see Terms of Access) and within a specially designed environment provided by the UMC Utrecht.
